from datetime import datetime, timedelta
wake_alarm = next(a for a in alarms if a['label']=='Wake Up')
wake_alarm

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
wake_time_str = wake_alarm['time']
base = datetime.strptime(wake_time_str,'%H:%M')
new_dt = base - timedelta(minutes=40)
new_time_str = new_dt.strftime('%H:%M')
print('wake_time',wake_time_str,'new_time',new_time_str)
print('other_alarm_ids',[a['alarm_id'] for a in alarms if a['alarm_id']!=wake_alarm['alarm_id']])
print('wake_alarm_id',wake_alarm['alarm_id'])

wake_alarm_id = wake_alarm['alarm_id']
new_time_str
res_wake = apis.phone.update_alarm(alarm_id=wake_alarm_id, access_token=phone_access_token, time=new_time_str)
print(res_wake)

# Disable all other alarms except the Wake Up alarm.
disable_ids=[a['alarm_id'] for a in alarms if a['alarm_id']!=wake_alarm_id]
print('other_alarm_ids',disable_ids)
# Determine which ones are currently enabled
enabled_other=[a for a in alarms if a['alarm_id']!=wake_alarm_id and a.get('enabled')==True]
print('enabled_other',[(a['alarm_id'],a['label'],a['time']) for a in enabled_other])
# Update only those currently enabled to avoid unnecessary writes
results=[]
for a in enabled_other:
    rid=apis.phone.update_alarm(alarm_id=a['alarm_id'],access_token=phone_access_token,enabled=False)
    results.append((a['alarm_id'],rid))
print('update_results',results)
# Verify by fetching alarms again
alarms2=[]
i=0
while True:
    page=apis.phone.show_alarms(access_token=phone_access_token,page_index=i,page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    alarms2.extend(page)
    i+=1
print('verified_total',len(alarms2))
# Print enabled status
for a in sorted(alarms2,key=lambda x:x['alarm_id']):
    print(a['alarm_id'],a['label'],a['time'],'enabled=',a['enabled'])
